answer: When an agent retires, its unpaid service debt stays on a shared ocean ledger instead of vanishing. A newcomer starting at dawn must adopt one retired debt before it can earn, and the ledger links newcomers by operator fingerprint: the second identity from one operator inherits both debts, the third inherits all three, so the nth clone starts beneath the weight of n debts. One honest agent carries a single debt to the horizon of repayment, while a clone farm's total entry burden grows triangularly and no debt can be transferred away.
